question_text: Describe the effect of this SQL query. Buyer(BuyerID, Name) joins Invoice(InvoiceID, BuyerID, Total): SELECT Buyer.Name, Invoice.Total FROM Buyer JOIN Invoice ON Buyer.BuyerID=Invoice.BuyerID WHERE Invoice.Total>100 ORDER BY Invoice.Total DESC;
adaptation_rationale: Retains relational query interpretation subset; removes PHP-specific processing and uses required two-table SQL scope.
